db-internals-deep-dive 1.0.0 — initial release

- Covers in-depth internals of PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, and Kafka.
- Maps deep-dive topics for each system: storage, replication, consistency, indexing, and operational tuning.
- Rotates topics per session, always at internal/engineering level.
- Includes structured output: mechanism, trade-offs, failure case, production advice, and a mini challenge.
- Designed to answer prompts seeking high technical depth on database and messaging internals.
